observed_velocity_convention: LOS; compare after inclination, PSF, slit and bin integration
assumptions: fixed Chabrier SPS stellar masses plus requested common mass offset
fixed photometric geometry; aligned axisymmetric orbital density
Gaussian 0.60 arcsec seeing; exponential emitting thin disk
cold gas omitted: no measured gas mass map available
signed density allowed; inward total equatorial force guarded to 10000 kpc

photometry.source: Dutton et al. 2011, SWELLS II, https://arxiv.org/abs/1101.1622
photometry.rotation_source: Table 4; observed H-alpha + [N II] velocities, not deprojected circular velocities
photometry.photometry_source: Table 2 SPS masses (Chabrier IMF); Table 3 chameleon shape parameters; Sections 2, 3, 6
photometry.gas_note: No resolved gas mass map supplied by this paper. The default pilot omits cold gas, as in its initial mass model. This is an assumption, not a measured zero.
photometry.distance_note: Recompute all angular-diameter distances from the stated cosmology. This gives 2.437736 kpc/arcsec, consistent with Section 2 and Table 4. The three distances printed in Section 4.4 are internally inconsistent with that scale and are not mixed into the calculation.

uncertainty_note: Point fits conditional on baryons and geometry. Alternative subsets are not posterior samples or confidence intervals.
